top_signals.title: Trump's US Team Met With Iranians Tuesday in New York
top_signals.summary: President Donald Trump said US officials had a “very good” meeting with Iranian representatives, a rare direct encounter that offers a fresh opportunity to restart talks to end the nearly seven-month war. Tyler Kendall reports. (Source: Bloomberg)
top_signals.why_it_matters: Geopolitical escalation affecting commodities, shipping and cross-asset volatility.

top_signals.summary: The storm brought record-breaking rainfall to eastern Japan, triggering landslides, flooding and widespread disruption of transport.
